summary: Smith & Nephew plc filed a Form 6-K notifying PDMR share transactions under UK Market Abuse Regulation. On 1 September 2026, equity awards were granted to Nate Folkert, President, Orthopaedics: a Performance Share Plan 2026 award of 117,933 ordinary shares (maximum vesting) and a Restricted Share Plan 2024 award of 67,164 ordinary shares, both priced at £11.0265 per share (ten-day average closing price post H1 results). Performance award vests 15 March 2029 subject to performance conditions; restricted award vests in equal annual tranches over three years subject to continued employment. No special situation; routine PDMR compensation disclosure.
